integrity: All assertions concern the normal-fan variety in the intrinsic cut-vertex lattice. Facet enumeration is independently executable, and infinite-field germ identifications are algebraically proved. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines reduced singular support and generic transverse toric analytic germs. It does not determine the nonreduced Jacobian scheme, conductor, or germs at component intersections. Unidentified equivalent literature may exist.
title: A 156-component mixed-dimensional singular locus on the \(K_{2,3}\) cut sixfold
